component.name: PDF Ebook Reader
component.summary: A calm, local-only PDF reading window

description.p: PDF Ebook Reader opens local PDF files in a focused single-page reading view with keyboard navigation, fit-to-window and manual zoom controls.
Reading positions and a small recent-books list are stored locally on the computer. The application does not upload documents or start a network service.
Initial MVP release with local PDF reading, persistence, and desktop integration.
